newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil 1996 import figures may be out next week.
newsitem.headline: Brazil 1996 import figures may be out next week.

text.p: Brazilian import figures for 1996 will probably be announced next week, said Everardo Maciel, head of the Internal Revenue Service.
"The import figures are ready and are at the disposal of the (Finance) Minister (Pedro Malan). The trade balance will probably come out next week," Maciel told Reuters.
Exports in 1996 totalled $47.7 billion. December is expected to have posted a $1.5 billion or more trade gap, bringing the 1996 deficit to some $5.0 billion or more.
